narrative.summary: owner() is a legacy multisig wallet that needs 3 of 6 signatures and has no timelock. It can issue, redeem, blacklist and change the fee parameters. There is no proxy.
narrative.detail: Added 2026-10-11. Scored 55 / 60 / 0 (composite 40) by the same convention as WBTC's legacy multisig: a 3-of-6 wallet that executes on confirmation, with nothing between a signed transaction and its effect. Read on two independent RPCs the same day.
